description: This Java class represents a JPA entity mapping for the 'GEOZONE_DESCRIPTION' table within the sales manager core module. It extends the Description class and establishes a many-to-one relationship with the GeoZone entity, encapsulating geographic zone descriptions tied to specific geo zones and languages.
